title: Beginner Linux Questions
definition: Foundational interview questions testing basic navigation, file management, and core command-line competency.
simpleExplanation: Proving you can walk around the terminal without deleting the operating system.
realWorldExample: Interview Question: 'How do you find your current directory, list the files including hidden ones, and read the contents of a text file?'

basic: How do you recursively delete a directory and all of its contents?
intermediate: What is the difference between an absolute path and a relative path?

answers.question: Absolute vs Relative?
answers.answer: An absolute path starts from the root directory (`/var/www/html`). A relative path starts from your current location (`../html`).
